title: Short Selling Pressure, Stock Price Behavior, and Management Forecast Precision: Evidence from a Natural Experiment

scopes.description: The assigned release is an online appendix reporting Tables OA1–OA14 for a Reg SHO natural experiment, including multiple forecast-news measures and an alternative event window. The complete paper-wide author workflow, inputs, and output-to-code map are unknown from this document-only material.

requirements.description: Author-prepared analysis inputs and specifications for the appendix Reg SHO analyses, including the reported 34,096 firm-quarter full sample in event window [-8,+7], plus the complete paper-wide analysis inputs. The appendix does not provide a compatible analysis-data route or full input/variable construction specification.

issues.description: No author program or executable workflow is supplied in this release; the assigned inventory contains only the online-appendix PDF.

The appendix reports additional analyses and robustness checks, but does not specify the complete paper-wide workflow, all analysis inputs and construction, entry points, or code supporting Tables OA1–OA14. Paper-wide requirements cannot be inferred from this document-only release.

evidence.description: The assigned work-item inventory lists one material file, li-zhang-online-appendix.pdf, and no dependency edges; the static audit reports only that PDF and no supported code.
The supplied document identifies itself as the online appendix to the titled paper.
The appendix reports added analyses and robustness checks, with results under both traditional and Rogers–Van Buskirk forecast-news measures.
evidence.quote: All results affected by forecast news are presented under both the traditional forecast news calculation and the Rogers and Van Buskirk [2013] news measure.

evidence.description: The appendix reports a 34,096 firm-quarter sample in event window [-8,+7], but does not provide the underlying analysis input.
evidence.quote: which includes 34,096 firm-quarters in the event window [-8, +7]

evidence.description: The appendix enumerates supplemental outputs including the IBES-detailed-file robustness table and an alternative event window; these branches must remain in scope pending author workflow mapping.
evidence.quote: Table OA14: This table presents results on changes in management forecast precision around Reg SHO experiment under an alternative event window [-8, -1] and [+1, +8].

actions.description: Obtain the complete author replication materials and workflow specifications before defining or attempting the full paper replication scope.
steps: Request the complete paper-wide author release, including programs and all entry points, README or data documentation, author-prepared analysis inputs, and required software/version notes.
Request the authors’ mapping from every paper and appendix table/figure to its program, inputs, generated intermediates, and execution order, covering Tables OA1–OA14 and all reported branches.

Clarify how the required panel and both forecast-news measures are supplied or constructed, and how the alternate event window and IBES-based consensus branch fit the author workflow; do not infer historical raw-source dependencies from the appendix alone.
After receipt, verify the prepared data fields, identifiers, event-quarter period, forecast-news variants, and coverage against author instructions before assigning routes.
validation: Confirm the supplied release includes author programs and entry points for every documented paper and appendix output, or obtain an explicit author statement describing approved non-code alternatives.

Verify that author-prepared inputs cover the documented 34,096 firm-quarter sample and the required forecast-news variants and alternative-event-window outputs without assuming the summary tables are analysis data.
Only after workflow and inputs are fully specified, prepare a future authorized run plan and verify output coverage against the paper and online appendix.

review_notes: Assessment is limited to the assigned online-appendix PDF. Its contents enumerate OA1–OA14, report results using traditional and Rogers–Van Buskirk forecast-news measures, describe an IBES detailed-file analysis, and include an alternative event window. These reported branches are retained in the requested author workflow mapping.

No analysis_only scope is justified: this release supplies no author analysis code or underlying author-prepared analysis data with a supported compatible route. The complete paper-wide workflow remains explicitly unknown.
